case_title: SHARAD HIRU KOLAMBE v. STATE OF MAHARASHTRA AND OTHERS
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to various terms of imprisonment and fines
neutral_facts: The accused, along with five other individuals, were tried and convicted for offences punishable under Sections 364A, 395, 397, and 387 of the Indian Penal Code, as well as Sections 3(1)(ii), 3(2), and 3(4) of the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act. The accused was sentenced to various terms of imprisonment and fines. The trial court imposed a fine of Rs.15,04,000/- and a default sentence of 10 years in case of non-payment. The accused was in custody for 14 years and had completed three years of the default sentence. The accused's family was in a state of starvation, and the fine amount was considered excessive. The accused's financial condition was taken into account, and the default sentence was reduced to three years and four months in total.
